A <br> inside an inline code span splits the span and emits a hard break

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>X <code>A<br>B<br>C</code></p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
